def test_rounded_avg():
    # n > m â -1
    assert rounded_avg(7, 5) == -1
    assert rounded_avg(10, 1) == -1

    # Single element
    assert rounded_avg(5, 5) == bin(5)          # "0b101"

    assert rounded_avg(1, 5) == "0b11"          # avg = 3
    assert rounded_avg(10, 20) == "0b1111"      # avg = 15
